prompt: The client is deciding which segment of the market to enter. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Budget is over twice the size of premium
options.feedback: True, but budget is shrinking while premium grows 75% in three years.

options.text: Premium is already larger than budget
Premium has better margins, so it's more profitable
options.feedback: The chart shows market size, not margins. That may be true, but nothing here supports it.

options.text: Premium grew 75% in three years while budget shrank
options.feedback: Right. Premium went from 20 to 35; budget fell from 80 to 75.

explanation: Premium grew 75% in three years (20 to 35); budget fell from 80 to 75.
